question: In 1861, Archaeological Survey of India was founded by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alexander Cunningham**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Archeological Survey of India**:

 
 
• It was **founded **by **Alexander Cunningham **in **1861**.
 
• He also **became **its **first Director-General**.
 
• **Sir Alexander Cunningham **was a **British army engineer **with the **Bengal Engineer Group**.
 
• **Alexander Cunningham **was **appointed **to the newly created position of **archaeological surveyor **by the **government of India **in **1861**.
 
• The (ASI) Archaeological Survey of India is an Indian government agency attached to the Ministry of Culture.
 
• ASI is responsible for archaeological research and the conservation and preservation of cultural monuments in our country. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Saurabh Kumar **is an **Indian cricketer **who plays for **Uttar Pradesh**. 
 
• **Jayanti Patnaik **M.A. is an **Indian Parliamentarian **and renowned **social worker**. She was the **first Chairperson **of the **National Commission for Women**.
 
• **Girish Kumar Taurani **is an **Indian actor **working in the **Hindi film industry**.​
